data.exact_reserve_text: Overall, on an aggregate basis, a reserve release of GBP 1.3m (2013: strengthening GBP 2.9m) net of reinsurance was made from prior year reserves.
data.standardized_narrative: For the 2014 financial year, Syndicate 1910 reported a net reserve release of GBP 1.3 million from prior year reserves. This favorable development was attributed to prior years developing in line with expectations, with no need for further reserve strengthening. The opening gross claims outstanding for the year was GBP 69.876 million. No specific events or lines of business were detailed as contributing to this movement.
raw_causal_phrases: Losses continue to develop, both positively and negatively on these open balances.
Prior years have developed in line with expectation and there has not been any need for further reserve strengthening.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: The prior year development figure of -1.3m GBP is explicitly stated as 'net of reinsurance' in the report. No gross prior year development figure was available.
